f9nVggLDSlausUi4SlyV.description:
Being the most imposing and physically strongest of the rank-and-file Nobodies is surprisingly not the most notable thing about **Berserkers**. Instead, it is their strange relationship with their *Claymores*; each **Berserker** and its *Claymore* seem fundamentally linked. They are able to act independently even when separated, and both entities have been observed appearing to control the other. It is not clear which is the weapon and which is the wielder.

**Berserkers** most often appear alongside other Nobodies, though they are less numerous than their smaller cousins. As their name suggests, **Berserkers** prefer to be on the front lines of combat, punishing whichever enemy is nearest, while the lesser Nobodies engage any other targets. They are not afraid of injury, and will place themselves where their *Magna Storm* ability can devastate the maximum number of foes.

The mere presence of these brute Nobodies seems to infect sentient beings with a sickening rage. Survivors of **Berserker** encounters report being overcome by a blinding fury when struck by these creatures' massive *Claymores*;  the vitriol only subsided once the **Berserkers** were destroyed.

*Original art by Tetsuya Nomura.*

special.name: Taunting Strike
special.effect:
